column3: FastAPI exposes the ASGI application's root_path through AppInfo; the empty string represents the root mount, instead of composing framework-specific prefixes.

Svelte uses a keyboard-accessible combobox backed by q and limit=50; selecting a route applies its basePath, method, media headers and an empty JSON body when needed, without sending. Route parameters remain editable in the path field.
The ported tool description includes authorization evidence, but sharpit has no request-journal authorization source; this remains with lane B4.
